title: Tesla at Wardenclyffe tapping the ether

tellings.quote: Tesla was doing at Wardenclyffe, high voltages, short distances, where he's claiming to tap the ether for free energy,

plain: In the early 1900s the inventor Nikola Tesla is said to have worked with high voltages over short distances at Wardenclyffe, his laboratory in New York, claiming he could tap the ether, an old idea of a medium filling all space, for free energy. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, while talking with a guest named Dave Rossi. If it were true, energy could be drawn from space itself.
